description: Register of the claims, thresholds and labels used by the collector, the engine and the reports, with the state of their foundation. Rendered in docs/sources.en-US.md and docs/sources.pt-BR.md by tools/Sync-Sources.py; checked by tools/Test-ClaimRegister.py.

statuses.VERIFIED_OFFICIAL: The page was opened in full and the quoted statement supports the claim.
statuses.VERIFIED_CVE: Confirmed in the NVD record that cites the MSRC advisory.
statuses.KIT_CRITERION: A criterion of this kit, not a Microsoft recommendation. The rationale says why it exists.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: Not yet confirmed in an official source; the todo says what must be checked. The result still shows it, but it must not be presented as official.

claim.en-US: Only Connected Machine agent versions released within the last year are officially supported.
claim.pt-BR: Só as versões do agente Connected Machine lançadas no último ano têm suporte oficial.

sources.title: Overview of the Azure Connected Machine agent
Manage Azure Connected Machine agent versions

entries.evidence: "Only Connected Machine agent versions within the last year are officially supported by the product group."

claim.en-US: Agent release months used to date a version: 1.57 (2025-10) to 1.69 (2026-10).
claim.pt-BR: Meses de lançamento do agente usados para datar uma versão: 1.57 (2025-10) a 1.69 (2026-10).

sources.title: What's new with the Azure Connected Machine agent

entries.evidence: Release notes headings 'Version 1.60 - January 2026' to 'Version 1.69 - October 2026' match the table. Versions 1.57 to 1.59 are corroborated by the release calendar of the Arc agent support workbook (https://github.com/fabiotreze/AzureArcBRTips/tree/main/workbooks/arc-agent-support), not by the page section opened.

claim.en-US: Agents below 1.61 are affected by CVE-2026-26117 (local elevation of privilege, CVSS 7.8). The floor 1.61 is the highest fixed version among the Arc agent CVEs listed here.
claim.pt-BR: Agentes abaixo da 1.61 são afetados pelo CVE-2026-26117 (elevação local de privilégio, CVSS 7,8). O piso 1.61 é a maior versão corrigida entre os CVEs do agente Arc listados aqui.

entries.evidence: NVD: product 'Arc Enabled Servers - Azure Connected Machine Agent', affected versions 1.0.0 up to (excluding) 1.61.

claim.en-US: CVE-2025-55316 affects agents below 1.56.
claim.pt-BR: O CVE-2025-55316 afeta agentes abaixo da 1.56.

entries.evidence: NVD: Azure Connected Machine Agent, affected 1.0.0 up to (excluding) 1.56.

claim.en-US: CVE-2025-49692 affects agents below 1.49.
claim.pt-BR: O CVE-2025-49692 afeta agentes abaixo da 1.49.

entries.evidence: NVD: Azure Connected Machine Agent, affected 1.0.0 up to (excluding) 1.49.

claim.en-US: CVE-2025-26627 is not mapped to an agent version: NVD lists product 'Azure ARC' below 1.0.10, which does not correspond to the Connected Machine agent numbering. It is not shown per machine.
claim.pt-BR: O CVE-2025-26627 não é mapeado a uma versão do agente: o NVD lista o produto 'Azure ARC' abaixo de 1.0.10, que não corresponde à numeração do agente Connected Machine. Ele não aparece por máquina.

entries.todo: Confirm in the MSRC advisory which component and fixed agent version apply before listing it per machine.

claim.en-US: Automatic agent upgrade requires agent 1.67 or later (Windows: PowerShell execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux: cron). It is available only in the Azure public cloud.
claim.pt-BR: O upgrade automático do agente exige o agente 1.67 ou superior (Windows: política de execução RemoteSigned; Linux: cron). Só está disponível na nuvem pública do Azure.

sources.title: Automatically upgrade the Azure Connected Machine agent

entries.evidence: "All Arc-enabled servers: Azure Connected Machine agent version 1.67 or later is required."

claim.en-US: The local setting automaticupgrade.blocklocally takes precedence over the Azure property enableAutomaticUpgrade: when true, automatic upgrades are blocked even if the Azure property is true. It is read on the machine with 'azcmagent config get automaticupgrade.blocklocally', not through Azure.
claim.pt-BR: A configuração local automaticupgrade.blocklocally tem precedência sobre a propriedade do Azure enableAutomaticUpgrade: com valor true, os upgrades automáticos ficam bloqueados mesmo que a propriedade do Azure seja true. Lê-se na máquina com 'azcmagent config get automaticupgrade.blocklocally', não pelo Azure.

sources.title: Automatically upgrade the Azure Connected Machine agent (section: Block automatic agent upgrades locally)

entries.evidence: "The automaticupgrade.blocklocally setting takes precedence over the enableAutomaticUpgrade property." The option was introduced in agent 1.61 (release notes: 'Added option to disable automatic upgrades locally').

claim.en-US: A supported agent more than 6 months old is a warning.
claim.pt-BR: Um agente com suporte, mas com mais de 6 meses, é um alerta.

entries.rationale: Microsoft publishes a 12-month support window, not a 6-month one. The kit warns at half of the window so the upgrade is planned before support ends.

claim.en-US: Microsoft supports Azure Monitor Agent versions released within the last year only.
claim.pt-BR: A Microsoft só dá suporte às versões do Azure Monitor Agent lançadas no último ano.

sources.title: Azure Monitor Agent extension versions

entries.evidence: "Microsoft supports Azure Monitor Agent versions released within the last year only."

claim.en-US: Only Azure extension for SQL Server versions released within the last year are supported.
claim.pt-BR: Só as versões da extensão do Azure para SQL Server lançadas no último ano têm suporte.

sources.title: Release notes - SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "Only Azure extension for SQL Server versions released within the last year are supported."

claim.en-US: The current auto-upgrade target of the Azure extension for SQL Server is 1.1.3518.465 (August 2026); the live value read from Azure takes precedence when higher.
claim.pt-BR: O alvo atual do upgrade automático da extensão do Azure para SQL Server é 1.1.3518.465 (agosto de 2026); o valor lido do Azure prevalece quando for maior.

sources.title: Release notes - SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "The current auto-upgrade target version of the Azure extension for SQL Server is 1.1.3518.465".

claim.en-US: SQL extension below 1.1.2859.223 is reported.
claim.pt-BR: Extensão SQL abaixo de 1.1.2859.223 é reportada.

sources.title: Release notes - SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

entries.todo: The release notes (checked 2026-11-06) do not state a minimum version. 1.1.2859.223 is a November 2024 release ("Minor bug fixes") and the current auto-upgrade target is 1.1.3518.465 (August 2026). Decide whether to keep it as a kit criterion with a rationale or replace it by a 12-month window computed from the release table.

claim.en-US: A machine that stays disconnected for 45 days might become Expired and needs to be disconnected and reconnected (new onboarding) to be managed again.
claim.pt-BR: Uma máquina que permanece desconectada por 45 dias pode passar para Expired e precisa ser desconectada e reconectada (novo onboarding) para voltar a ser gerenciada.

sources.title: Azure Arc-enabled servers overview - Agent status

entries.evidence: "If a machine remains disconnected for 45 days, its status might change to Expired. An expired machine can't be managed through Azure Arc until a server administrator disconnects and then reconnects it to Azure. ... The credential is valid for up to 90 days and renews every 45 days."

claim.en-US: A machine disconnected for 30 to 44 days is in the warning band, before the 45-day expiry.
claim.pt-BR: Uma máquina desconectada por 30 a 44 dias está na faixa de alerta, antes da expiração de 45 dias.

entries.rationale: Microsoft documents the 45-day point, not a 30-day one. The kit warns 15 days earlier so the machine can be reconnected before it expires and a new onboarding is needed.

claim.en-US: Windows Server 2012/2012 R2 ESU ends on 2026-10-13; ESU licenses enabled by Azure Arc are deactivated at 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-14. ESU through Arc for 2012 needs agent 1.34 or later.
claim.pt-BR: O ESU do Windows Server 2012/2012 R2 termina em 2026-10-13; as licenças ESU habilitadas pelo Azure Arc são desativadas às 00:00 UTC de 2026-10-14. O ESU pelo Arc para o 2012 exige o agente 1.34 ou superior.

sources.title: Prepare to deliver Extended Security Updates for Windows Server through Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "The three-year ESU period ends on October 13, 2026 ... At midnight UTC on October 14, 2026, Windows Server 2012 ESU licenses enabled by Azure Arc are deactivated".

claim.en-US: Windows Server 2016 reaches end of support on 2027-01-12; ESU can be configured in the Azure portal from 2026-08-03 and billing through Azure Arc starts on 2027-01-13; the agent must be 1.62 or later.
claim.pt-BR: O Windows Server 2016 chega ao fim do suporte em 2027-01-12; o ESU pode ser configurado no portal do Azure a partir de 2026-08-03 e a cobrança pelo Azure Arc começa em 2027-01-13; o agente deve ser 1.62 ou superior.

sources.title: Prepare to deliver Extended Security Updates for Windows Server through Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "Windows Server 2016 reaches end of support on January 12, 2027 ... starting August 3, 2026 ... Billing ... begins January 13, 2027 ... use agent version 1.62 or higher."

claim.en-US: ESU delivered through Azure Arc is documented for Windows Server 2012, 2012 R2 and 2016; Windows Server 2008 is not listed.
claim.pt-BR: O ESU entregue pelo Azure Arc está documentado para Windows Server 2012, 2012 R2 e 2016; o Windows Server 2008 não consta.

sources.title: Extended Security Updates (ESU) for Windows Server with Azure Update Manager

entries.evidence: "By using Azure Update Manager, you can deploy Extended Security Updates for your Azure Arc-enabled Windows Server 2012, 2012 R2, and 2016 machines." The Arc ESU pages list no other Windows Server version.

claim.en-US: incomingconnections.ports lists the local ports the Azure Arc connectivity channel may reach (several ports are separated by commas). SSH uses port 22 by default (a single port per service configuration) and Windows Admin Center is deployed through the AdminCenter extension on a configurable port (the examples use 6516). Any other port is reported as unclassified.
claim.pt-BR: incomingconnections.ports lista as portas locais que o canal de conectividade do Azure Arc pode alcançar (várias portas se separam por vírgula). O SSH usa a porta 22 por padrão (uma única porta por configuração de serviço) e o Windows Admin Center é implantado pela extensão AdminCenter em uma porta configurável (os exemplos usam 6516). Qualquer outra porta é reportada como não classificada.

sources.title: Manage Azure Arc-enabled servers using Windows Admin Center in Azure
SSH access to Azure Arc-enabled servers
CLI reference for azcmagent config

entries.evidence: WAC page: "azcmagent config set incomingconnections.ports <port> ... you can specify multiple ports separated by a comma"; deployment example `$wacPort = "6516"` with extension AdminCenter (publisher Microsoft.AdminCenter). SSH page: "You may only allow connection to a single port", default 22.

claim.en-US: A SQL usage upload older than 24 hours is reported as stale.
claim.pt-BR: Um envio de uso do SQL com mais de 24 horas é reportado como desatualizado.

sources.title: Manage Licensing and Billing - SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "If usage uploads aren't received for more than 24 hours, check the following things"; "Periodically verify that usage reporting is functioning correctly by reviewing the Last Usage Upload Time in the Azure portal."

claim.en-US: A SQL Server machine with pay-as-you-go must check in with Azure at least every 30 days; beyond 30 days disconnected, billing switches to recurring charges based on the last known configuration.
claim.pt-BR: Uma máquina SQL Server com pay-as-you-go precisa se comunicar com o Azure ao menos a cada 30 dias; acima de 30 dias desconectada, a cobrança passa a ser recorrente com base na última configuração conhecida.

sources.title: Manage the transition to pay-as-you-go billing - SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc

entries.evidence: "Azure Arc-connected servers must check in with Azure at least once every 30 days." / "If the machine remains disconnected for more than 30 days, the SQL Arc service switches to recurring billing based on the last known configuration." Charges include backfill for the previous 30 days; a changed VM ID can cause double billing.

claim.en-US: The Activity Log keeps 90 days natively.
claim.pt-BR: O Activity Log guarda 90 dias de forma nativa.

sources.title: Activity log in Azure Monitor - Retention period

entries.evidence: "Azure retains activity log events for 90 days and then deletes them." Longer retention needs a diagnostic setting that sends the entries elsewhere.

claim.en-US: A Log Analytics workspace that receives Arc data and keeps less than 90 days is a warning.
claim.pt-BR: Um workspace do Log Analytics que recebe dados do Arc e retém menos de 90 dias é um alerta.

entries.rationale: Microsoft does not set a minimum retention for security investigations; 90 days matches the native Activity Log window and is the kit's default for detection and audit.

claim.en-US: Defender recommendations open for 90 days or more are counted separately in the detail (informational).
claim.pt-BR: Recomendações do Defender abertas há 90 dias ou mais são contadas à parte no detalhe (informativo).

entries.rationale: A reading aid for stale recommendations; it does not change the result.

claim.en-US: A Defender recommendation with High severity that affects an Arc machine is a verified gap (FAIL); only lower severities are an improvement opportunity (WARN).
claim.pt-BR: Uma recomendação do Defender de severidade High que afeta uma máquina Arc é uma lacuna verificada (FAIL); só severidades menores são oportunidade de melhoria (WARN).

entries.rationale: The recommendation exists and is unhealthy in Defender for Cloud, so the condition is observed. The mapping from High severity to FAIL is the kit's.

claim.en-US: Azure Policy guest configuration (machine configuration) and Change Tracking & Inventory list at USD 6 per server per month.
claim.pt-BR: Azure Policy guest configuration (machine configuration) e Change Tracking & Inventory custam USD 6 por servidor por mês (preço de lista).

sources.title: Azure Arc pricing - core control plane

entries.evidence: "Azure Policy Guest Configuration and Change Tracking & Inventory | $6/server/month | $0.009/server/hour". Prices change; the report states it is an estimate, not an invoice.

claim.en-US: List prices in USD used for the monthly estimate (Defender for Servers P1/P2, Update Manager, Machine Configuration, Windows Server pay-as-you-go).
claim.pt-BR: Preços de tabela em USD usados na estimativa mensal (Defender for Servers P1/P2, Update Manager, Machine Configuration, Windows Server pay-as-you-go).

sources.title: Azure Arc pricing

entries.todo: Only the guest configuration price (USD 6) is published on the Azure Arc pricing page checked on 2026-11-06 (see PRICES-GC); the page shows placeholders for Defender for Servers and Update Manager and does not list the Windows Server pay-as-you-go rate. Re-check these values on the Defender for Cloud, Update Manager and Windows Server pay-as-you-go pricing pages; the report states it is an estimate, not an invoice.

claim.en-US: The kit index is not the Defender for Cloud Secure Score. Microsoft gives each control a fixed maximum score and divides it by the healthy and unhealthy resources; the kit weights controls by severity (High 3, Medium 2, Low 1) and scores them by the share of healthy machines.
claim.pt-BR: O índice do kit não é o Secure Score do Defender for Cloud. A Microsoft dá a cada controle uma pontuação máxima fixa e a divide entre os recursos saudáveis e não saudáveis; o kit pondera os controles por severidade (Alta 3, Média 2, Baixa 1) e os pontua pela proporção de máquinas saudáveis.

sources.title: Cloud Secure Score in Microsoft Defender for Cloud

entries.rationale: A reading aid to rank work inside this report. The official measure is the Secure Score of Defender for Cloud.
entries.evidence: Learn: "Max score ... is fixed for every environment"; "Score per resource = max score / (healthy + unhealthy resources)".

claim.en-US: Residual risk scores map to priorities P0 (80 or more), P1 (60), P2 (35) and P3. It prioritizes posture work; it is not an incident severity.
claim.pt-BR: As pontuações de risco residual se traduzem em prioridades P0 (80 ou mais), P1 (60), P2 (35) e P3. Prioriza trabalho de postura; não é severidade de incidente.

entries.rationale: Deterministic model defined by this project (checkpoint 3 and 4); documented in docs/v4/methodology-v4.md.

claim.en-US: The 11 security scenarios (AS01-AS11) and their attack paths are hypotheses written by the author; an attack is never asserted as confirmed.
claim.pt-BR: Os 11 cenários de segurança (AS01-AS11) e seus caminhos de ataque são hipóteses escritas pelo autor; um ataque nunca é afirmado como confirmado.

entries.rationale: Scenarios link controls to a reading of risk. They carry attackConfirmation=NOT_ASSERTED.

claim.en-US: The mapping of each check to Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark controls, Zero Trust principles and pillars, and tiers is the author's reading, with a mapping confidence per check.
claim.pt-BR: O mapeamento de cada verificação para controles do Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, princípios e pilares do Zero Trust e tiers é a leitura do autor, com um nível de confiança por verificação.

entries.rationale: Reading aid; not a compliance mapping. See mappingConfidence in assurance/v4/checkpoint3/data/checks.enriched.json.
